messages:
Alex: Heads-up — Bridgeport POC kickoff scheduled for next Wed. Need a quick catalog sanity check and variant compatibility pass before we hand off to SRE. Primary asks: KV-prefix caching support, quantized 8-bit variants, KMS for customer keys, and a rough pricing ballpark for ~100k requests/mo. Ping SEs and infra.
Priya: Got it. Can you list which model variants they've proposed? Also I'll run the automated compatibility script. Example command I use locally: `ri-check-model --model <model-name> --quant <quant> --kv-check`
Alex: They mentioned: `llama-3-7b-chat`, `fine_tuned_bridge_v1` (ft on domain data), and `qlora-7b-v2` for cheaper inference. Customer wants chat+structured outputs.
Marco: Quick note — qlora / Q4/Q8 variants can expose KV cache alignment issues depending on kernel paths. On our Dedicated runtime we sometimes see higher memory pressure for 2048 tokens. Suggested short-term fallback: cap seq_len to 1024 for qlora variants or serve a non-quantized variant when p95 SLA tight.
Jess: Security heads-up: Bridgeport requires KMS integration and a completed security questionnaire (they want encryption-at-rest + BYOK). We can support KMS on Dedicated + Private; hosted requires ICP approval for BYOK. Also confirm: do they expect us to persist raw prompts? We'll need that for the questionnaire.
Alex: They said no long-term raw prompt storage; only transient logs for debugging if enabled. I'll confirm and get their questionnaire today.
Priya: Next steps: I'll queue the `ri-check-model` runs for the three variants against a small warmup corpus. Marco — can you run a smoke test on dedicated-pool-2 once I push the job? I want to validate 95th latency with seq_len 512 and with/without KV cache.
Marco: deploy-bot: scheduling warmup job on `dedicated-pool-2` for `qlora-7b-v2` and `llama-3-7b-chat`.
deploy-bot: [log]
```
warmup: model=qlora-7b-v2 pool=dedicated-pool-2 threads=8
result: ERROR OOM at step=34 seq_len=2048 MALLOC_FAIL
suggested: reduce batch_size or cap seq_len
```
Marco: Saw OOM on qlora-7b-v2 at seq_len 2048 with default batch=4. With seq_len=512 it completed warmup but p95 increased ~1.6x compared to non-quant variant. We should tune batch_size and consider KV cache off for QLORA on Dedicated to avoid fragmentation.
Priya: That's useful. Alex — what's their latency SLO and typical sequence length? Also any concurrency expectations?
Alex: They want p95 < 200ms for chat, avg seq len ~512, expected ~100 concurrent sessions (peak ~200). Pricing ask: they asked for a rough hosted vs dedicated estimate for the POC (1 month).
Marco: Rough back-of-envelope: Hosted (our API) for chat @ ~300 tokens/request ~= $0.03/request => ~100k reqs -> ~$3k in usage. Dedicated: reserved node + infra for similar throughput probably ~ $6k-$9k/month depending on commit and autoscaling. If they need BYOK/KMS and private networking, add integration/setup (~one-time professional services) — say $8k band. I'll get precise numbers from finance.
Jess: For questionnaire: ask them to confirm data residency (EU/US), KMS provider, and whether they need replay logs. We'll block BYOK on hosted until compliance signs off. Also require 30-day lead time for Private deployments.
Alex: Perfect. I'll confirm retention and residency and pull their security questionnaire into the thread. Scheduling a 30-min sync tomorrow with Bridgeport + SEs to align on sequence len and expected payloads. Priya — after your checks, can you drop a short compatibility matrix in the GH doc? I'll add pricing ranges and security notes.
Priya: Yep — will upload `compat_matrix.md` to the repo and ping this thread. I'll include recommended config (seq_len cap, batch_size defaults, KV on/off per variant) and a one-page ops checklist for the POC.
Alex: Thanks all — will follow up after the sync. :thumbsup:
